* '''Double Elimination Bracket''' **{{Abbr|BO3|Best of Three}} games **Procedure: /cmd rnd Pick Pick Toss Toss Toss Toss Toss Toss Play ** ''Winner of /cmd rnd picks and tosses first.'' **{{Abbr|BO5|Best of Five}} games **Procedure: /cmd rnd Pick Pick Pick Pick Toss Toss Toss Toss Play ** ''Winner of /cmd rnd picks and tosses first.'' **Picks alternate unless one player is trailing map score. *'''Grand Finals''' **Grand Finals is {{Abbr|BO7|Best of Seven}}. **Procedure: /cmd rnd Pick Pick Pick Pick Pick Pick Toss Toss Play ** ''Winner of /cmd rnd picks and tosses first.'' **Picks alternate unless one player is trailing map score. == 4on4 Draft - Friday January 9== {{Maps |title= |map1=dm2 |map2=dm3 |map3=e1m2 |map4=schloss |map5=phantombase }} '''Games start: 11:00'''
* '''Group Stage''' **Round Robin, all-play-all in group **Top 2 advance to Playoffs **{{Abbr|BO3|Best of Three}} games **Procedure: /cmd rnd Pick Pick Toss Toss Play ** ''Winner of /cmd rnd picks and tosses first.'' *'''Single-Elimination Playoffs''' **Quarterfinals are {{Abbr|BO3|Best of Three}} games **Procedure: /cmd rnd Pick Pick Toss Toss Play ** ''Winner of /cmd rnd picks and tosses first.'' *'''Semifinals & Grand Finals''' **Semifinals & Grand Finals is {{Abbr|BO5|Best of Five}} **Procedure: /cmd rnd Pick Pick Pick Pick Play **Picks alternate unless one team is trailing map score. The ranking in the group stage is determined by taking the following stats into account (in order): * Points (1 point per match win). * Map difference. * Internal fight. * Map difference in those internal fights. * Frag difference in those internal fights. * Total frag difference of all games. == 4on4 Clan - Saturday January 10== {{Maps |title= |map1=dm2 |map2=dm3 |map3=e1m2 |map4=schloss |map5=phantombase }} '''Games start: 11:00'''
* '''Double-Elimination''' **{{Abbr|BO3|Best of Three}} games **Procedure: /cmd rnd Pick Pick Toss Toss Play ** ''Winner of /cmd rnd picks and tosses first.'' *'''Semifinals & Grand Finals''' **Winners Bracket Semifinals & Grand Finals are {{Abbr|BO5|Best of Five}} **Bronze match is {{Abbr|BO5|Best of Five}} **Procedure: /cmd rnd Pick Pick Pick Pick Play **Picks alternate unless one team is trailing map score. ==Signing up== To register for any of the 3 official tournaments, you need to sign up by messaging {{Player|Peppe|flag=se}} on Discord or in person. =====Clean Language requirement===== We enforce a Clean Language rule for team names. Please avoid using sexual, political, hateful or in other ways inappropriate language, as the event will be broadcasted to a wider audience than the local community. This of course applies to nickname switching or any other variations of trying to be funny. If you don't follow these simple rules, you may be removed from the tournament. ==Server Settings== * Timelimit: ** 20 minutes in 4on4 with 5 minutes of overtime ** 10 minutes in 1on1 with 3 minutes of overtime * Teamoverlay: OFF * Antilag: 2 * If you're unsure, use /1on1 /2on2 or /4on4 in console. ==Client Settings == * Allowed clients: EzQuake 3.6.8 or later * Allowed ruleset: smackdown or qcon '''NOTE! ruleset smackdrive is NOT allowed''' ==Match Reporting== * The team/player that wins has to report the match in the #match-reporting channel on the QHLAN Discord. * A report consists of screenshots and server-side MVDs. ** Use match_auto_sshot 1 to automatically save screenshots of played games. ==Added rules== * Pause ** We will limit pauses in this time to '''One pause per team/player per match''' Issues can happen, but try to be aware that we are on a tight schedule. * SOCD/idrive ** This feature will '''NOT''' be allowed, set up your keyboard properly and change your ruleset to smackdown or qcon. With the new detection feature we will enforce a map loss for the player/team that are detected using SOCD. The debate has been long and at times heated, with the latest detection for SOCD being available and the issues it has produced for some players, we have made the decision to not allow this feature. '''If any of these rules are broken it will result in the forfeit of the current map.''' ''Any form of wallhack or aimbot will result in disqualification, eviction from the LAN and being shamed for all eternity.'' __NOTOC__
